# Geetanjali Home Appliances

> Geetanjali Home Appliances is an Indian cookware and pressure cooker brand manufactured by Harsh Home Appliances in Delhi NCR. With over 30 years of manufacturing experience, the company produces ISI-certified pressure cookers and triply cookware distributed pan-India.

## Brand Overview
- **Brand Name**: Geetanjali Home Appliances
- **Parent / Manufacturing Entity**: Harsh Home Appliances
- **Industry**: Kitchenware, Pressure Cooker & Cookware Manufacturing
- **Established**: Over 30 years of manufacturing excellence (since 1997)
- **Certification**: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) ISI Certified
- **Manufacturing Location**: Sector-2, Bawana Industrial Area, Delhi - 110039, India
- **Market Presence**: Pan-India B2B distribution, wholesale network, and direct consumer supply

## Manufacturer Details
- **Company Name**: Harsh Home Appliances
- **Factory Address**: K-11, Sector-2, Bawana Industrial Area, Delhi - 110039, India
- **Facility**: Integrated pressure cooker and stainless steel triply cookware manufacturing plant
- **Phone Hotline**: +91 9205293094, +91 8287634365
- **Official Email**: geetanjalihomeappliances.india@gmail.com
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/geetanjalihomeappliancesindia (@geetanjalihomeappliancesindia)

## Product Catalog

### 1. Pressure Cooker Collection
Geetanjali Home Appliances manufactures ISI-marked pressure cookers ranging in capacity from 1.5 Litres to 22 Litres across four distinct series:

#### Trinity Series (Triply Stainless Steel)
- **Construction**: 3-ply metal structure — Food-grade SS 304 inner layer, heavy Aluminium core, SS 430 magnetic outer base.
- **Sizes**: 1.5L, 2L, 3L, 5L, 7.5L, 10L, 12L.
- **Shapes / Lids**: Inner Lid (Classic, Contura), Outer Lid (Regular, Handi).
- **Features**: Induction & gas compatible, 360-degree heat distribution, anti-bulge induction base, ISI certified safety valve system.

#### Stello Series (Stainless Steel 304)
- **Construction**: Heavy-gauge food-grade SS 304 mirror-polished body with heavy sandwich bottom induction base.
- **Sizes**: 1.5L, 2L, 3L, 5L, 7.5L, 10L.
- **Shapes / Lids**: Inner Lid (Contura, Classic) and Outer Lid (Handi, Regular).
- **Features**: Rust-proof, acid-resistant, heavy-duty metallic safety valve and food-grade silicone gasket.

#### Black Beauty Series (Hard Anodized)
- **Construction**: Heavy-gauge hard-anodized aluminium (2.4x harder than stainless steel).
- **Sizes**: 1.5L, 2L, 3L, 5L, 7.5L, 10L.
- **Shapes / Lids**: Inner Lid and Outer Lid models with matte black finish.
- **Features**: Non-reactive to acidic food, scratch-resistant, rapid heating, heat-resistant Bakelite handles.

#### Alex Series (Pure Aluminium)
- **Construction**: Heavy-gauge virgin aluminium for high thermal conductivity.
- **Sizes**: 1.5L, 2L, 3L, 5L, 7.5L, 10L, 12L, 16L, 20L, 22L.
- **Shapes / Lids**: Outer Lid Regular & Handi; Inner Lid Contura.
- **Features**: Lightweight, fast thermal response, durable build for home and institutional commercial cooking.

---

### 2. Cookware Collection

#### Trident Series (Triply Clad Cookware)
- **Technology**: 3-Layer SAS structure (SS 304 inner + Aluminium core + SS 430 magnetic outer).
- **Products**:
  - **Kadhai with Glass / Steel Lid**: 20cm, 22cm, 24cm, 26cm, 28cm, 30cm.
  - **Tasra (Deep Skillet)**: 20cm, 22cm, 24cm, 26cm.
  - **Tope (Milk / Curry Pot)**: 1L to 8L capacities.
  - **Saucepan with Handle**: 1.5L, 2L.
  - **Frypan**: 20cm, 22cm, 24cm.
  - **Stewpan / Stewpot**: 3L, 5L, 8L.
- **Features**: 100% toxic-free cooking surface, stackable, metal-spatula resistant, induction and gas compatible.

#### Tricomb Series (Triply Honeycomb Hybrid Non-Stick)
- **Technology**: Laser-etched stainless steel honeycomb mesh over PFOA-free non-stick coating on a tri-ply base.
- **Products**:
  - **Honeycomb Dosa Tawa**: 28cm, 30cm.
  - **Honeycomb Roti Tawa**: 26cm, 28cm.
  - **Honeycomb Frypan**: 22cm, 24cm, 26cm.
  - **Honeycomb Kadhai**: 24cm, 26cm, 28cm with lid.
  - **Honeycomb Tasra**: 22cm, 24cm.
- **Features**: Scratch-proof, 100% metal spatula safe, hybrid crisp searing with 80% less oil consumption, PFOA-free.

## Certifications & Quality Compliance
- **ISI Certified**: Pressure cookers comply with BIS IS 2347 quality and safety norms.
- **Food-Grade Standard**: Stainless steel products utilize SS 304 (18/8) compliance for contact surfaces.
- **Multi-Level Safety System**: Fitted with Gasket Release System (GRS), Gasket Vent System (GVS), and Metallic Fusible Safety Valve.

## Shipping Coverage
- **Pan-India Delivery**: Direct factory supply and logistics covering all states and union territories in India, including North India (Delhi NCR, Punjab, Haryana, UP, Rajasthan), West India (Gujarat, Maharashtra), South India (Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Kerala), and East/Northeast India.

## Unique Selling Points (USPs)
1. **Direct Factory Manufacturer**: 30+ years manufacturing legacy in Bawana Industrial Area, Delhi.
2. **Factory-Direct Pricing**: Eliminates middleman markups for competitive pricing without quality compromise.
3. **Comprehensive Range**: Pressure cookers from 1.5L home sizes up to 22L commercial sizes.
4. **Triply & Honeycomb Innovation**: Advanced 3-ply clad steel and scratch-proof honeycomb non-stick tech.
5. **Multi-Stage Quality Control**: 100% hydrostatic and pneumatic pressure safety testing.
